description: Change server settings at runtime without editing .env or restarting. Only a short list of safe settings can be changed here.
hint: Applies on the next request; long-running queue workers pick it up on restart.
empty: No server settings are available to change.
forbidden: Your admin role does not include server settings yet. Ask a root admin to save your admin account again to grant it.
unavailableTitle: Not available on this server version
unavailable: This DreamFactory server does not support changing server settings from the admin interface. Upgrade the server to use this page. Until then, the log level comes from the .env file.
saveError: Could not save the change. The previous value is unchanged.
savedStale: System Info and the System overview may show the previous value until you reload the page.
resetMessage: The override will be removed and the value from .env will apply again.
